name: Orchestrator.inc
tagline: Desktop workspace that plans work and runs parallel agents in isolated worktrees.
description: A local desktop app that runs a project-level orchestrator agent, which breaks outcomes into tasks and delegates them to worker sessions, each with its own branch and worktree. A local daemon tracks terminals, changed files, CI and review state, and a companion mobile app connects over LAN or Tailscale while execution stays on your machine.

pricing.notes: Open source under Apache-2.0; a cloud offering is listed as a waitlist.
